_about: Operations on which a schema-valid request is correctly refused, so the single check positive_data_acceptance (valid data must be accepted) is skipped for them; every other check still runs. This file is the only list: tests/contract/test_openapi_contract.py and scripts/contract_cli.sh both read it, and a test fails if an entry does not match the OpenAPI document. 'suites' says which runner skips the check.

operations.reason: end_date >= start_date spans two fields, which OpenAPI 3.0 cannot state (FR-028); answered 422 projects.date_range_invalid
same date-order rule as the create (FR-028)
a time zone must be a name the system can load (FR-217), which no schema can state; any short string is schema-valid and a made-up one is answered 422 sites.timezone_invalid
same time zone rule as the create (FR-217)
the command-line run itself creates users and then guesses their passwords, so the account lockout (423) is the designed answer
